post.summary: Act as a moderator on a post, a comment or a member
post.description: A community's moderators, its owner and Samtak's platform moderators act; each only on what an account of a lower rank wrote, or on such an account (member, moderator, owner, platform moderator). Every action is logged with its reason. A hidden post or comment is shown only to moderators; a removed one too, until its text is deleted 90 days after the removal. A muted member reads but does not post, comment or react until `until`; a removed one may join again; a banned one may not, and reads nothing. With `reportId`, the report is closed by the same action.
